@hono/zod-openapi: Hono routes with OpenAPI from Zod schemas (http)
@opentelemetry/api: the tracing and metrics API: span attributes and context (authn, error-tracking, http, queue, telemetry) and counters (cache, live, queue, telemetry)
@opentelemetry/core: W3C trace context propagation for Events; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (queue)
@opentelemetry/exporter-logs-otlp-proto: exports logs over OTLP; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/exporter-metrics-otlp-pro: exports metrics over OTLP; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-proto: exports traces over OTLP; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/instrumentation-http: spans for Node HTTP; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/instrumentation-pg: spans for Postgres queries; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/instrumentation-pino: trace ids in log lines; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/instrumentation-redis: spans for Redis commands; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/instrumentation-runtime-n: Node runtime metrics; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/instrumentation-undici: spans for fetch; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/sdk-logs: OpenTelemetry logs SDK; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/sdk-metrics: OpenTelemetry metrics SDK; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/sdk-node: OpenTelemetry Node SDK; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@opentelemetry/sdk-trace: OpenTelemetry tracing SDK; pinned exactly, as OpenTelemetry's packages must match each other (telemetry)
@standard-schema/spec: the schema type callers pass, from any schema library (cache, queue)
@types/pg: types for the pg client a caller passes (postgres)
commander: parses command line arguments and builds help (cli)
drizzle-orm: SQL queries and table schemas on Postgres; pinned exactly to its release candidate until 1.0 is out (postgres)
ky: fetch with timeouts and retries, in Node and browsers; pinned exactly, as sdk-fetch.ts copies how ky reads retry headers to predict its wait (sdk)
react: client hooks for a React UI, optional peer (live)
react-router: middleware and loaders for a React Router UI, optional peer (authn, live)
zod: schemas inside authn; http's peer, as @hono/zod-openapi needs it (authn, http)
